title: Glory Days - Full Song
original_lyrics:
[verse]
Glory Days

[bridge]
Full Song

[verse]
I had friend was big baseball player

[bridge]
He could throw that speedball by you
Make you look like fool boy
Saw him the other night at this roadside bar
I was walking in and he was walking out
We went back inside sat down, had few drinks,

[chorus]
Glory days well they'll pass you by
Glory days in the wink of young girl's eye
Glory days, glory days

[verse]
There's girl that lives up the block

[bridge]
Sometimes on Friday I'll stop by and have few drinks
after she put her kids to bed
Her and her husband Bobby well they split up
I guess it's two years gone by now
We just sit around talking about the old times,
she says when she feels like crying she starts laughing thinking about

[chorus]
(Palm Mute)
Think I'm going down to the well tonight
and I'm going to drink till I get my fill
And I hope when I get old I don't sit around thinking about it

[bridge]
Yeah, just sitting back trying to recapture
little of the glory of,
